name: Acceptance test 20 - mixed policy family blocks (originally passing; protect against regression)
note: IAM-707 fixturization of an originally-PASSING case. Under identity mode, a document that mixes an identity grant (s3:GetObject on a Resource) with a trust element (Principal:* + sts:AssumeRole) is NOT a valid single family. The engine fails closed with AMBIGUOUS_POLICY_SHAPE, citing statement 1 (the Principal-bearing trust statement). The trust statement is not silently discarded and the two statements are NOT combined into an attack path. This is CORRECT FINAL behavior (not design-blocked).
